desc: Set the permission type for who can access an app

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

permission_type.desc: The type of permission that defines who can access the app

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs to allow for named_entities visibility

access_denied.desc: This actor does not have access to the permissions on this resource.

invalid_permission_type.desc: This app requires permission_type to be set as named_entities before adding users.

named_entities_cannot_be_empty.desc: Must pass at least one valid named entity.

no_valid_named_entities.desc: None of the provided named entities were valid

too_many_named_entities.desc: Too many named_entities passed into the app permissions setting.

not_an_enterprise.desc: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.

user_not_found.desc: This actor does not have access to at least one valid named entity.

invalid_channel_restriction_mode.desc: The channel_restriction_mode value is not valid.

channel_ids_required.desc: channel_ids is required when channel_restriction_mode is specific_channels or all_channels_except.

channel_not_found.desc: One or more channel IDs are not valid.
